three.js 0.186.1 (https://threejs.org, npm "three"), MIT License: see LICENSE.
three-viewer.js is three.js plus OrbitControls, GLTFLoader, STLLoader, OBJLoader, PLYLoader and RoomEnvironment,
bundled and minified from tools/three (cd tools/three && npm install && node build.mjs).
Loaded only when a 3D model is opened.
